messages:
Sam (AE): Kicking off the Sunburst trial. Quick sync to align success criteria, infra handoffs, and any security blockers. Proposed agenda: intros, success criteria, prompt/eval plan, infra + SSO/KMS, pricing expectations, timeline. Available Tue 4/9 10am PT?

Jules (Sunburst): Tue 10am PT works. Main use case: classify incoming support tickets and generate short summaries for agents. Secondary: answer retrieval from knowledge base.

Maya Chen (SE): Got it. For the ticket classifier — do you expect multi-label or single-label? Also would like sample tickets (50-200) for initial eval prompts.

Jules (Sunburst): multi-label. Can share 200 anonymized tickets by EOD tomorrow. Any preferred format? CSV ok.

Alex S: CSV is perfect. Also include labels column and a sample of edge cases (long threads). We'll run a small eval harness against those.

Priya R: Heads up on security checklist: are we going to require a full SCC or does the customer accept our SOC2 + DSAR addendum? Also, any PHI in tickets? That affects the Private deployment ask.

Jules (Sunburst): No PHI. They said some PII but can be redacted. They want to see SOC2 + a short Q&A; if Private is required we'll discuss later.

Sam (AE): Pricing note — customer expects a 3-month trial with committed capacity for steady throughput. Maya/Alex, can you estimate cost for 10k messages/day with 512 token avg? We should give a ballpark before Tue call.

Maya Chen (SE): Rough calc: with batching and prefix caching expect ~60M tokens/month. On hosted tiers that maps to estimate $X–Yk/month. I'll put exact numbers in a follow-up.

Alex S: Also confirming SLOs they care about: median latency <200ms for classification path, and under 1.5s for long-summary generation. Is that right Jules?

Jules (Sunburst): Yes those are our targets. Accuracy target: >92% F1 on core labels. For summaries, avg human rating >=4/5 on clarity.

Priya R: For the security handoff: we'll need their IP allowlist, SSO IdP metadata (SAML or OIDC), and confirmation on data retention/retention policy. I can send the security questionnaire link.

Sam (AE): Action items so far: (1) Jules to share anonymized CSV (owner: Sunburst) by EOD tomorrow; (2) Maya/Alex to produce cost + infra plan before Tue; (3) Priya to circulate security questionnaire and checklist; (4) Sam to send calendar invite.

Jules (Sunburst): Timeline wise: 3-week evaluation looks good for us. Week1: data ingest + basic eval. Week2: prompt tuning and model config. Week3: run production-like load and finalize results.

Maya Chen (SE): Sounds good. For week1 we need FTP/secure share or S3 access. Prefer S3 presigned link or temporary role. Please include a couple sample KB articles for retrieval tests.

Alex S: Small note on success criteria instrumentation: we'll push a test harness that records latency, token counts, and per-prompt quality labels. Please define the evaluation rubric for summary ratings (e.g., 1-5 scale with guidelines).

Jules (Sunburst): I'll draft a simple rubric: 5=excellent (concise, accurate), 4=good, 3=acceptable with small omissions, 2=inaccurate, 1=bad. We'll attach 30 human ratings for Week1.

Priya R: If they prefer hosted but want data isolation, we can propose a Dedicated instance for the trial — higher cost but meets isolation ask. If they lean on hosted, we need written confirmation on redaction process.

Sam (AE): Pricing ask for sales: propose two options in the follow-up (hosted trial small discount vs dedicated short-term commitment). We'll include a conditional add-on for Private deploy if they require on-prem later.

Alex S: Quick sample eval prompts (for the harness):
```
# classification prompt
"Classify this ticket into labels: [billing, technical, feature, account, other]. Output JSON: {\"labels\": [..]}"

# summary prompt
"Summarize the user's issue in 1-2 sentences and list next steps the agent should take."
```

Maya Chen (SE): I'll prepare a short runbook for the customer on how to run the eval harness and where to drop artefacts. Will include token breakdown examples.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created by Sam (AE) for Tue 2024-04-09 10:00 PT — Sunburst Trial Kickoff (channel: #sales). :calendar:

Sam (AE): Thanks everyone. If no blockers, I'll lock the invite and circulate the draft SOW + trial T&Cs today. Jules — anything else we should cover on Tue?

Jules (Sunburst): Please include the list of required accesses and a simple success dashboard we'll look at during Week3. Otherwise all good. :thumbsup:
